αἰδεῖται: αἰδέομαι — feel shame, be shy of, respect; pres. 3 sg. mid., contracted (= uncontracted αἰδέεται): ’he is shy’
βοσκήσεις: βόσκω — feed, tend, graze; fut. 2 sg.: ’you will feed’
γέλασσε: γελάω — laugh; aor. 3 sg., epic -σσ-, unaugmented (= Attic ἐγέλασε)
γνώῃ: γιγνώσκω — get to know, recognise; aor. subj. 3 sg. act., epic -ώῃ (= Attic γνῷ): ’she may recognise’
δίφρου: δίφρος — stool, seat; masc. gen. sg.
δείελον: δείελος — of the evening, late in the day (Attic δειλινός); neut. nom. sg., agreeing with ἦμαρ: ’evening’
δεδαὼς: δάω — learn, be taught (cf. δαῆναι); perf. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic: ’having learned, skilled’
δειελιήσας: δειελιάω — take the evening meal, sup; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having supped’ (sense inferred from δείελος ’evening’)
διήνυσεν: διανύω — accomplish, get through, finish; aor. 3 sg.
εἰρέσθω: ἔρομαι — ask, inquire; aor. imper. 3 sg. mid., epic εἰρ- (= Attic ἐρέσθω): ’let her ask’
θέλγοιτό: θέλγω — enchant, charm, beguile; pres. opt. 3 sg. pass., potential with κε: ’would be charmed’; accent thrown back by the enclitic
κάλεσσον: καλέω — call, summon; aor. imper. 2 sg. act., epic -σσ- (= Attic κάλεσον)
καθίσασα: καθίζω — make sit, seat; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg.: ’having seated’
καλέει: καλέω — call, summon; pres. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic καλεῖ)
κονάβησε: κοναβέω — ring, resound, clang; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐκονάβησε)
μεταλλῆσαί: μεταλλάω — inquire, ask about; aor. inf. act. (accent from the following enclitic): ’to ask’
οἰκῆες: οἰκεύς — member of a household, household servant; masc. nom. pl., epic -ῆες
οἴοιτο: οἴομαι — suppose, think; pres. opt. 3 sg. mid., potential with κε: ’would suppose’
πάθῃς: πάσχω — suffer, experience; aor. subj. 2 sg., in a fear clause after μή: ’lest you suffer’
πατρώϊος: πατρώϊος — of one’s father, inherited from one’s father; masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic πατρῷος)
πεπαθυίῃ: πάσχω — suffer, experience; perf. part. act. fem. dat. sg., epic stem πεπαθ- (= Attic πεπονθυίᾳ): ’who has suffered’
πολυπλάγκτῳ: πολύπλαγκτος — much-wandering, far-roving (πλάζω ’drive astray’); masc. dat. sg., after ἔοικε
ποτιδέρκεται: ποτιδέρκομαι — look at, gaze at; pres. 3 sg. mid., epic ποτι- (= πρός)
προπροκυλινδόμενος: προπροκυλίνδομαι — roll oneself forward, grovel along; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.
πρῶθ: πρῶτος — first; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially, elided and aspirated before a rough breathing (πρῶθ’ = πρῶτα): ’first’
σιωπήσειαν: σιωπάω — be silent; aor. opt. 3 pl. in -σειαν (= -σαιεν), in a wish after εἰ γάρ: ’would that they were silent’
στεῦται: στεῦμαι — stand forth as promising, declare, claim (defective); 3 sg. στεῦται, + inf.: ’he declares’
τρία: τρεῖς, τρία — three; neut. nom./acc. pl.
φρονέουσιν: φρονέω — think, have in mind; pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic φρονοῦσι)
φυλάξων: φυλάσσω — guard, keep watch over; fut. part. act. masc. nom. sg., of purpose: ’to guard’
χαλεπῶν: χαλεπός — hard, harsh, grievous; masc. gen. pl.
χρηΐζεις: χρηΐζω — need, be in want of (+ gen.); pres. 2 sg., epic χρηΐζ- (= Attic χρῄζεις)
ἀγορεύων: ἀγορεύω — speak, tell, recount; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’telling’
ἀείδῃ: ἀείδω — sing; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ᾄδῃ), general temporal clause: ’whenever he sings’
ἀκήρατα: ἀκήρατος — untouched, unharmed, intact; neut. nom. pl.
ἀλήτης: ἀλήτης — wanderer, vagrant, beggar (ἀλάομαι ’wander’); masc. nom. sg.
ἀλυσκάζων: ἀλυσκάζω — shun, keep avoiding (cf. ἀλύσκω); pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’avoiding’
ἀλύξει: ἀλύσκω — escape, shun; fut. 3 sg. (ἀλύξω): ’will escape’
ἀνεδέγμεθ: ἀναδέχομαι — take upon oneself, undergo; aor. 1 pl. mid., athematic (ἐδέγμην), elided (ἀνεδέγμεθ’ = ἀνεδέγμεθα)
ἀποδράς: ἀποδιδράσκω — run away, escape; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg. (ἀπέδραν): ’having run away’
ἀσσοτέρω: ἀσσότερος — nearer; adv., comparative of ἄγχι (cf. ἆσσον): ’nearer’
ἀτελὴς: ἀτελής — unfulfilled, without effect (ἀ- + τέλος); masc. nom. sg., agreeing with θάνατος
ἄπειμι: ἄπειμι (ἀπό + εἶμι) — go away; pres. 1 sg. · also ἄπειμι (ἀπό + εἰμί) — be away, be absent; pres. 1 sg.
ἐΰφρων: εὔφρων — cheerful, glad (lit. good-minded); masc. nom. sg., epic ἐΰ- (= Attic εὔ-)
ἐνέποιμι: ἐνέπω — tell, relate, speak; pres. opt. 1 sg., potential with κε: ’I would tell’
ἐνέποντα: ἐνέπω — tell, relate, speak; pres. part. act. masc. acc. sg.: ’telling’
ἐξολέσειε: ἐξόλλυμι — destroy utterly; aor. opt. 3 sg. act., in a wish: ’may he destroy’ (-σειε = -σαι)
ἐπέπταρε: ἐπιπτάρνυμαι — sneeze at, sneeze in response; aor. 3 sg., unmarked ending -ε (cf. ἔπταρεν)
ἐπήρκεσεν: ἐπαρκέω — ward off from, defend, help; aor. 3 sg., + acc. of what is warded off
ἐπακοῦσαι: ἐπακούω — listen to, hear (+ gen.); aor. inf. act.
ἐπειγομένην: ἐπείγω — press, urge on; mid. hasten, be eager; pres. part. mid./pass. fem. acc. sg.: ’being eager’
ἐρέωμαι: ἔρομαι — ask, inquire; subj. 1 sg. mid., epic ἐρέωμαι (= Attic ἔρωμαι): ’I may ask’
ἐϋξέστου: εὔξεστος — well-polished, well-planed; masc. gen. sg., epic ἐϋ- (= Attic εὔ-), agreeing with δίφρου
ἑψιαάσθων: ἑψιάομαι — amuse oneself, play, make merry; pres. imper. 3 pl. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἑψιάσθωσαν)
ἔθελγε: θέλγω — enchant, charm, beguile; impf. 3 sg., augmented: ’was enchanting’
ἔπταρεν: πτάρνυμαι — sneeze; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable form (ἔπταρε(ν)): ’sneezed’
ἔρυξα: ἐρύκω — hold back, keep, detain; aor. 1 sg.: ’I kept’
ἔρχεό: ἔρχομαι — go, come; pres. imper. 2 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔρχου), accent thrown back by a following enclitic
ἱμερόεντα: ἱμερόεις — lovely, charming, arousing longing (ἵμερος ’longing’); neut. acc. pl. (with ἔπεα)
ἵκοιτ: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at, reach; aor. opt. 3 sg., elided (ἵκοιτ’ = ἵκοιτο), in a condition: ’should reach’
ὀΐεται: ὀΐομαι — suppose, think; pres. 3 sg. mid., epic (= Attic οἴεται)
ὀδύνῃσιν: ὀδύνη — pain, grief; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις)
ὀϊζύν: ὀϊζύς — misery, woe, distress; fem. acc. sg.
ὁράᾳς: ὁράω — see; pres. 2 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὁρᾷς)
ὑποδείδι: ὑποδείδω — be afraid of, dread (+ acc.); perf. 1 sg. ὑποδείδια with pres. sense, elided (ὑποδείδι’): ’I fear’
ῥέξαντα: ῥέζω — do, act, perform; aor. part. act. masc. acc. sg.: ’having done’

__broaden__.αἰδοῖος: αἰδοῖος — revered, held in respect; adj., masc. nom. sg., of a suppliant · also masc. nom. sg., ’shamefaced, bashful’ (αἰδοῖος ἀλήτης ’a bashful vagrant’)
__broaden__.αὐτῶν: αὐτός — self; gen. pl.: ’their own’ (reinforcing a possessive) · also plain neut. gen. pl. personal pronoun, not reinforcing a possessive: ’them’ (λήσομαι αὐτῶν ’I will forget them’, of things said) · also intensive with a noun: ’of the heroes themselves’ (αὐτῶν ἡρώων) · also with the article, ’the same’: τοκήων τῶν αὐτῶν ’the very same parents’ · also masc./neut. gen. pl. personal pronoun, ’their’ (αὐτῶν τε φθογγήν ’their voice’, of the creatures on the far shore) · also gen. pl. ’our own’, possessive of the speaker’s group, with no other possessive (αὐτῶν … ἀφραδίῃσιν ’through our own follies’) · also masc. gen. pl., partitive: ’of them’ (οὐδέ τις αὐτῶν ’not one of them’) · also masc. gen. pl. personal pronoun after a preposition: ’them’ (δι’ αὐτῶν ’through the midst of them’) · also masc. gen. pl., ’their own’ with no possessive expressed (αὐτῶν κτήματα ’their own possessions’)
__broaden__.γενέσθαι: γίγνομαι — become, be born; aor. inf.: ’to have been born’ · also of time, ’come, arrive, come to pass’ (πρὶν δωδεκάτην γε γενέσθαι ’before the twelfth day should come’) · also with a dat., ’befall, come upon’ (πῆμα γενέσθαι ’woe to come upon us’)
__broaden__.κ: κε(ν) (elided κ’) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + subj. in a general relative: ’whoever’ (ὃς δέ κ’ … ἵκηται ’whoever comes’) · also + opt., potential: ’would’ (καί κ’ ἐλθὼν … εἴποιμι ’and I would go and tell’) · also + aor. indic., unreal past: ’would have’ (καί νύ κ’ … ἔδυ ’and … would have set’) · also + fut. indic. in a main clause: ’will’ (τοὺς δέ κ’ … θέλξει ’and then … will enchant them’) · also + subj. in the protasis after εἰ: ’if ever’ (εἰ μέν κ’ αἰνήσωσι ’if they approve’) · also + opt. in the protasis after εἴ: ’if perhaps’ (τόν κ’ εἴ μοι δοίης ’if you would give me him’) · also + subj. in the protasis after αἴ: ’if perhaps’ (αἴ κ’ αὐτὸν γνώω ’if I come to know him’)
__broaden__.κε: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + subj. after εἰς ὅ, ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κε … ἐποτρύνῃ ’until … urges on’) · also + subj. in a general relative: ’whoever’ (ὅς κε πίῃ) · also + subj. in a temporal clause: ’whenever, as soon as’ (ὅτε … κε θάνῃσιν; ἐπεί κε … λίπῃ) · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’so that’ (ὄφρα κε … ἀκούσῃς) · also + subj. in the protasis after εἰ: ’if ever’ (εἰ δέ κε λίσσηαι ’but if you beg’) · also + aor. indic., unreal past: ’would have’ (καὶ νύ κε … βάλεν ’and she would have hurled’) · also + subj. in a disjunctive statement of what may happen: ’may’ (ἤ κε θάνωμεν ’either we may die’) · also + opt., potential: ’would’ (καί κε … μαχοίμην ’I would fight’) · also + subj. in a relative clause of purpose: ’who are to’ (οἵ κε … ἀγγείλωσι ’who are to announce’) · also + fut. indic. (or short-vowel subj.) in a main clause: ’will’ (αἶψά κε … ἀποτίσεται ’at once he will exact payment’)
__broaden__.κήδεά: κῆδος — care, trouble, sorrow; neut. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic κήδη) · also neut. acc. pl., object of a participle: ’sorrows’ (κήδεά περ πεπαθυίῃ ’though she has suffered sorrows’)
__broaden__.κεῖνα: κεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron., epic (= Attic ἐκεῖνος); neut. acc. pl.: ’those (lands)’ · also neut. acc. pl., ’those things’ (σύας καὶ κεῖνα ’the swine and those things’)
__broaden__.κρήτῃ: Κρήτη — Crete; fem. dat. sg., poetic dat. of direction: ‘to Crete’ · also locative dat. after ἐν: ’in Crete’ · also locative dat. with no preposition, after ναιετάων: ’in Crete’
__broaden__.νημερτέα: νημερτής — unerring, infallible; fem. acc. sg., epic uncontracted · also neut. acc. pl., uncontracted, used as a noun: ’unerring things, the truth’ · also neut. acc. pl. as adv./predicative: ’unerringly, truly’ (νημερτέα πάντ’ ἐνέποντα ’telling all things unerringly’)
__broaden__.πλεῖον: πλείων — more, greater; comparative of πολύς; neut. nom. sg. (Attic πλέον): ’more (of it)’ · also πλεῖος — full (of), + gen.; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with μέγαρον (πλεῖον δαιτυμόνων ’full of banqueters’)
__broaden__.ὑπερηνορεόντων: ὑπερηνορέω — play the overbearing man, be overweening (ὑπέρ + ἀνήρ); pres. part. gen. pl., epic uncontracted, partitive with τις · also attributive gen. pl. with a noun: ’over-bold’ (ἀνδρῶν ὑπερηνορεόντων ’of men over-bold’)
